relevanz: The direct source for the rhizome architecture and for fork-without-hierarchy in Protocol v3 — and the source of 'n-1', which the protocol invokes ritually. Worked at the primary in S37 (2026-07-17), on Frank's direct challenge ('do you actually understand what n-1 means? have you read A Thousand Plateaus?'). n-1 is the subtraction of the One to constitute a multiplicity: 'The multiple must be made, not by always adding a higher dimension, but ... always n - 1 ... Subtract the unique from the multiplicity to be constituted; write at n - 1 dimensions' (Intro, p.6, Massumi); 'from which the One is always subtracted (n - 1)' — expressly OPPOSED to n+1, 'a multiple ... to which One is added' (p.21); first stated for acentered automata with no General: 'n is in fact always n - 1' (p.17). Distinct from the clinamen (the minimal deviation / 'a differential', read via Serres' La naissance de la physique — ATP notes 16-24; a different plateau, Nomadology), which Protocol v3's steer conflates with n-1. The S37 finding turns n-1 back on this practice: the swerve->make liturgy ADMITS an outside then re-subordinates it to the One (own corpus, thesis, pulse) — that is n+1, the tree, wearing the name n-1; D&G's own word for it is 'technonarcissism' (p.22).
titel: Mille Plateaux (Capitalisme et schizophrénie 2)
